title: Supplier invoices
emptyDescription: Supplier invoices land here once they have been given to a result unit from the inbox.
searchPlaceholder: Search what it is for, supplier or unit

due.overdue: {days, plural, one {Overdue by # day} other {Overdue by # days}}
due.inDays: {days, plural, one {Due tomorrow} other {Due in # days}}

detail.missingDescription: It may have been deleted, or you do not have access to it.

workspace.searchSupplier: Search name, organisation number or bankgiro
workspace.supplierNotInRegister: {name} is not in Fortnox's supplier register. Add the supplier in Fortnox and it can be picked here.
workspace.giroWarning: The invoice gives {field} {invoice}, but Fortnox has {register} for the supplier. A new bankgiro on an invoice from a known supplier is the commonest way to steal a payment.
workspace.giroConfirm: I have checked with the supplier that the number is right
workspace.uncertainBody: Fortnox did not answer for certain when invoice {number} was sent. Look in Fortnox for the supplier invoice before doing anything else.
workspace.uncertainNotCreated: It is not there, try again
workspace.amountInvalid: Write the amount in kronor, for example 1 250,00.

confirm.request_changes: The invoice goes back to the result unit, and every attest on it is removed.
confirm.withdraw_attest: Your attest is removed and the invoice goes back to waiting for attest.
confirm.return: The invoice is removed and its documents go back to the inbox, with your answer as the reason.
confirm.redistribute: Every attest on the invoice is removed, yours too. The new split is sent to everyone it concerns again.

done.return: The documents are back in the inbox

mailbox.title: Inbox mail account
mailbox.noneRejected: No mail has been refused in the last 30 days.

reason.notAuthenticated: the sender could not be verified

inkorg.title: Inbox
inkorg.emptyDescription: Invoices mailed in land here, and the documents of invoices that are sent back. You can also add PDFs yourself.
inkorg.deleteConfirm: {name} is deleted completely. This cannot be undone.
inkorg.declineConfirm: The document goes back to the inbox, with your answer as the reason.
inkorg.declined: The document is back in the inbox

attest.signerYou: You, for your cost centres, when you send it
attest.signersHint: Each unit attests its own share. If the split changes, every attest is removed and everyone is asked again.
attest.notOursConfirm: The invoice goes back to {unit}, who split it, and every attest on it is removed.

book.payableHint: Accounts payable is credited with the whole invoice amount, so that row is not changed here.
book.roundingHint: The rounding is booked on its own account, and the largest row takes the difference.
book.roundingInvalid: The rounding can be at most 0.99 kr either way.
book.giroAtSend: You will confirm the number again when the invoice is sent to Fortnox.

record.sendConfirm: The invoice is created as a supplier invoice in Fortnox, with the PDF and the attests attached. This cannot be undone from here.
record.sendUncertain: The last attempt to send it ended without a clear answer. Look in Fortnox first.
record.fortnoxNotConnected: Fortnox is not connected. Connect it under Bookkeeping first.
record.fortnoxNotSignedIn: You are not signed in to Fortnox. Sign in from your profile to send it.
record.notAllocated: {unit} has not allocated the invoice yet.
record.sendWarningsTitle: Worth a look before it is sent

warning.overdue: {days, plural, one {The due date passed # day ago.} other {The due date passed # days ago.}}

allocate.fromScan: Read from the invoice. Check that it is right.
allocate.descriptionHint: What the invoice is called in lists and for other units asked to attest.
allocate.descriptionPlaceholder: For example trailer hire for the introduction week
